subject.title: feat(agents): add iteration budget for agent loop safety

question: Should OpenClaw accept this opt-in iterationBudget release contract, including the config names/defaults, model-tool-round budget unit, onBeforeToolCallingRound hook, budget_exhausted result, and unsupported-harness fail-closed behavior?
rationale: The implementation is coherent and tested, but it creates user-visible config plus core and harness API semantics that automation should not finalize without maintainer product intent.

options.title: Approve contract after rebase
options.body: Resolve the current conflicts and merge once maintainers accept the default-off config, budget unit, exhaustion result, and fail-closed unsupported-harness semantics.

options.title: Rename or narrow before release
options.body: Adjust any key names, defaults, hook semantics, or exhaustion behavior now because they become compatibility surface after shipping.

options.title: Pause behind #9912
options.body: Keep design discussion in the canonical issue if maintainers are not ready to bless a hard iteration-budget contract.

recommendation.title: Approve contract after rebase
